_comment: Copy this file to windows-drv-harness.config.json and fill in real values.
During environment checks, agents should create/update that local config first.
windows-drv-harness.config.json is gitignored; it may contain local VM paths and credentials.
Never commit windows-drv-harness.config.json and always redact secrets in chat output.
Agents may probe explicit input, this config, env vars, registry values,
and fixed default paths only. If a tool is still missing, ask the user.
It must be taken after guest VirtualKD/KDNET, VMware Tools, debug boot,
testsigning as needed, and guest admin credentials are ready.
admin_user/admin_password are the guest credentials used by vmrun/vmware-mcp
for copyFileFromHostToGuest and runProgramInGuest. If the user wants
persistent local credentials, fill the password here in plaintext.
Leave vmrun_path/vmmon64_path empty only if they are discoverable from
default locations, environment variables, or registry values.
vmmon64.exe must run before restoring/starting a VirtualKD snapshot.
